en: This black-and-white postcard shows a large, ornate building complex with half-timbered architecture, towers, and arched windows. The foreground features a meticulously maintained garden with walking paths and landscaped flower beds. The style is reminiscent of early 20th-century German spa or health resort architecture. The text at the top identifies the location as 'Bad Pyrmont' and the building as 'Genesungsheim Friedrichshöh.' The handwritten word 'Germ' also appears.
